issue.title: Multi component handling

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
- [x] Handles multiple components of a system.
- [x] Makes core to deal with standalone systems like a Land Robot, Standalone MAVLink camera, etc as well.
- [x] Changes class `Device` to `System`
- [x] Exposes generic `System` interface pushing back all MAVLink details in a dedicated `MAVLinkSystem` class. Plugins work with `MAVLinkSystem` class. Applications are forbidden to send MAVLink messages using `System` interface.
- [x] Adds integration test that discovers PX4 Autopilot and Camera component of the same.
- [x] Includes corresponding changes in backend.
- [x] Addresses
  - #304 
  - #317 
  - #318 
  - #319
  - #325,
  - #329 and
  - #331
